profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Bright Horizons
profile.summary:
I have experience across TypeScript, Python, Swift, Node.js, and C/C++. My background spans full stack product engineering, mobile development, cloud infrastructure, and applied AI, including agentic systems, LLM integrations across major model providers, RAG pipelines, vector databases, and long and short term memory architectures for production grade applications.

I co-founded Flopperam, where I created FlopAI, an AI code agent that gives developers natural language control of Unreal Engine, and authored an open source Unreal Engine MCP server with over 1.1k GitHub stars. Flopperam was acquired in 2026, and the combined product suite now serves more than 30,000 game developers.
 
I enjoy building practical, user focused software, whether that means modern web and mobile experiences or AI powered tools that solve real business problems. I have hands on experience across AWS, Azure AI services, and GCP, building and supporting cloud based systems end to end.

positions.title: Founder
positions.description:
Founded a company that was acquired by a YCombinator and a16z backed startup, Ramen VR (now Aura), with my co-founder, Chris Gong

- Built an AI development tool, similar to Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, etc., for Unreal Engine that was used by thousands of customers - https://flopperam.com
- Designed the client architecture: a C++ plugin running inside the Unreal Editor and a web frontend, both streaming to our agent backend via WebSockets
- Developed the agent backend of said tool using LangGraph, Python, various cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), OpenRouter, Supabase, and Upstash
- Built a following/community of over 10,000 followers, 9,000 of which was from YouTube alone - https://www.youtube.com/flopperam
- Developed and maintained the second most popular open-source MCP for Unreal Engine (over 1,100 stars) - https://github.com/flopperam/unreal-engine-mcp
